g.text: Institutional Event-Driven Perpetual Futures Exchange (CLOB) • Decoupled In-Memory Engine & Asynchronous Persistence
• Open Positions Dock with Live PnL
• Fills details: makerId, takerId, qty, price
• Immediate state hydration for new clients
• Unfilled Limit Order Margin Lock & Release
• Continuous Oracle Mark Price Liquidation Watcher
• Cold-Start State Hydration on Crash Recovery
• Decouples Matching Engine from Disk I/O
• Ingests trade executions from DB Pooler
• Builds active 1m OHLCV bar in RAM
• Periodic 5s Flush of closed bars to DB
• Orders: Ledger of all user orders & statuses
HTTP Client Request / Ingress Stream Read
